title: Ease of use and entry comparisons
summary: This topic mixes praise for an easier-to-use system and dedicated buttons with unclear or comparative remarks about entry, maneuvering, and control usability.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the infotainment system and dedicated buttons for making menus and settings easier to use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly contain comparative or incomplete comments about easier entry, maneuvering, button visibility, or seat movement without a clear overall evaluation.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster mixes multiple subjects, including infotainment controls, physical entry and exit, garage maneuvering, button brightness, and automatic seat movement.
Several fragments are comparative or incomplete and do not clearly state whether the customer viewed the vehicle attribute positively or negatively overall.
